description: This script is a command-line utility for fixing translation issues in markdown documentation files within a FastAPI project. It processes language-specific documentation files, compares translations to English versions, and auto-fixes discrepancies.

classes.name: typer.Typer
classes.description: Main CLI application object for command-line interface built with Typer.

methods.name: iter_all_lang_paths
methods.description: Iterates over markdown files in language directories in order of priority.

methods.name: get_all_paths
methods.description: Retrieves paths of documentation files for a specific language, excluding non-translated sections.

methods.name: process_one_page
methods.description: Fixes a single translated documentation page by comparing it to the English version and applying corrections.

methods.name: fix_all
methods.description: CLI command to process all documentation pages for a given language.

methods.name: fix_pages
methods.description: CLI command to process specific documentation pages provided as arguments.
